statement: ∀ i : ℕ, i ≠ 0 → (i.factorial : ℂ) = (i : ℂ) * ((i - 1).factorial : ℂ)
proof:
intro i hi
have hn : i = (i - 1) + 1 := by omega
have hh : i.factorial = i * (i - 1).factorial := by
  conv_lhs => rw [hn, Nat.factorial_succ]
  rw [← hn]
exact_mod_cast hh
